text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Education ministry devotes 1.4 billion dirhams ($140 million) during a three-year period to teachers and civil servants.
- Eleven people burnt to death after two lorries, one carrying petroleum products, collided in central city of Ben Ahmed.
_ SCP oil refinery workers to go on 48-hour strike.
- International Monetary Fund would grant loans only to countries which struggle against corruption.
- More than 748,000 tourists visited Morocco in the first half of 1997, up 8.8 percent over the same period last year.
- Islamist Democratic and Constitutional Popular Movement, led by Abdelkrim Khatib is expected to participate to legislative elections in September.
